shaders.name: outline_outer
shaders.title: Outline (outer)
shaders.about: Pixel-perfect outline around the opaque pixels, 1 to 8 px, 4-direction (pixel art) or rounded 8-direction. Grows the quad so the line is never cut.

shaders.name: hit_flash
shaders.title: Hit flash
shaders.about: Flashes the sprite to a solid color when it takes damage. Animate flash_amount from 1 to 0 with a Tween.

shaders.name: dissolve
shaders.title: Dissolve with burning edge
shaders.about: Noise dissolve with a two-color glowing edge. Pixel-perfect mode dissolves whole texture pixels. Animate progress 0 to 1.

shaders.name: crt
shaders.title: CRT monitor
shaders.about: Curved CRT screen with scanlines, RGB phosphor mask, color bleed and dark corners. Put it on a ColorRect on top of the game.
shaders.use: ColorRect over the screen (or any part of it)

shaders.name: wind_sway
shaders.title: Wind sway (grass, trees, plants)
shaders.about: Bends plants and trees in the wind with a gust on top, base anchored. Pixel snap moves whole pixels per row so pixel art stays crisp. Neighbours desync by world position.

shaders.name: rain_overlay
shaders.title: Rain
shaders.about: Three depth layers of slanted rain with pixel-width streaks, adjustable angle, density and speed, plus an overcast darkening.
